items.title: Blackberry Pie Jars
items.alt: Two open glass dessert jars with crumb bases, blackberries and cream beside a lid and loose berries.
items.description: Two open glass dessert jars with crumb bases, blackberries and cream beside a lid and loose berries. These individual crumb desserts suit a personal picnic menu or a classroom lesson on food containers.

items.title: Apple Turnover
items.alt: Golden triangular apple turnover with fork-crimped edges and visible apple filling on folded linen.
items.description: Golden triangular apple turnover with fork-crimped edges and visible apple filling on folded linen. Use this folded pastry as a food vocabulary illustration or a personal snack-menu accent.

items.title: Chicken Pot Pie
items.alt: Lattice-topped chicken pot pie in a blue handled dish with an open section showing chicken and vegetables.
items.description: Lattice-topped chicken pot pie in a blue handled dish with an open section showing chicken and vegetables. Place the savory pie beside a comfort-food journal entry or a classroom meal-planning activity.

items.title: Raised Meat Pie
items.alt: Tall meat pie with a woven pastry top and a separate cut wedge on a wooden handled board.
items.description: Tall meat pie with a woven pastry top and a separate cut wedge on a wooden handled board. The deep pastry walls and exposed filling suit a classroom comparison of savory and sweet pies.

items.title: Shepherds Pie in a Pan
items.alt: Mashed-potato-topped savory pie in a copper handled pan with an open portion revealing minced filling and vegetables.
items.description: Mashed-potato-topped savory pie in a copper handled pan with an open portion revealing minced filling and vegetables. The exposed filling suits a classroom meal vocabulary card or a personal comfort-food menu.

items.description: Fish pie in a pink rectangular dish with a browned potato topping and a serving opening showing fish and peas. Add the rectangular casserole to a personal meal plan or a classroom discussion of savory dishes.
